database.reason: The database partition HAS a database, so every DB-gated skip guard resolves to run. A skip whose reason is not declared below means the wiring broke and the shard reported green having executed nothing: the exact hole that let a fixture violating an alpha-3 baseline constraint reach main. Measured across all 16 shards of CI run 35805321083 (9af6ddc91): 5 skips, every one declared below.

unit.reason: The unit partition has no database by design, and a small number of tests are gated on capabilities the runner does not provide rather than on the database. Measured 1 on a full local unit partition; 2 leaves one slot of headroom so an unrelated capability gate does not red the build on the day it lands. Lower it when the count is confirmed on CI — this budget may only shrink.
